sloka: एष तस्मात्प्रणश्यामि दर्शनादस्य रक्षसः ।इत्युक्त्वा सरथः साश्वस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।। ७.२२.४९ ॥
transliteration: eṣa tasmātpraṇaśyāmi darśanādasya rakṣasaḥ ।ityuktvā sarathaḥ sāśvastatraivāntaradhīyata ।। 7.22.49 ॥

translations.english: What indeed can I do now, having come to battle, if this one (Ravana) cannot be killed by me because he is protected by a boon?
